assumptions.classification: combined union/full < threshold is sparse; equality is dense; labels assumed ready
assumptions.fetch: sparse union during current attention; dense full KV during previous-layer other work
assumptions.windows: one shared link, no cross-layer window pooling; layer 0 dense fetch is exposed
assumptions.compute: original sparse attention FLOPs at scaled MFU for both classes; other compute unchanged
assumptions.objectives: minimize unhidden fetch (equivalent to compute + unhidden); separately maximize hidden/fetch
assumptions.scope: offline tuning on one request, not executed DMA; excludes indexer, startup, first-tile waits and contention
